[SWS_PER_00552]
⌈
When ara::per::FileStorage::OpenFileReadOnly with
ara::per::OpenMode (or the overloaded version ara::per::FileStorage::-
OpenFileReadOnly with ara::per::OpenMode and separate buffer) is called,
Persistency shall first check whether the provided mode consists only of either
kAtTheBeginning or kAtTheEnd, and otherwise return directly with kInvali-
dOpenMode.
